title: Multivariate Laguerre polynomials: new results and insights
summary: In this paper, we study various properties of Erdélyi's multivariate Laguerre polynomials $L_{n_1,\cdots,n_k}^{(α)}(x_1,\cdots,x_k)$ including their generating functions, product formulas and fractional integral representations. Many useful consequences are derived. New insights into various classical results including the relationships of the multivariate Laguerre polynomials with Oshima's fractional calculus operator and with an integral formula of Srivastava and Niukkanen are also mentioned.
